transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well… I guess I may have gotten a little over-involved with the historical society fundraiser. I thought I could sort of handle the whole thing myself—quilt designs, calling volunteers, making schedules, setting deadlines. I was trying to be helpful, you know? But I may have promised more than I could realistically do.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?

Yes… I mean, I didn’t think of it as a problem at the time. I was just getting a lot done. For a while I was only sleeping a few hours, and then I’d wake up feeling ready to sew or make phone calls, like I should use the time. That sounds a little excessive when I say it out loud, doesn’t it?

Lately it’s been different, though. Now I’m either lying awake worrying, or I sleep late and still feel worn out.
During that time when you were sleeping only a few hours, did you also feel unusually cheerful or 'up'?

Yes… I did, at least at first. I felt almost… glowing, I guess, like every idea I had was a good one and I was finally doing something worthwhile. I don’t want to make it sound grandiose or anything, but it felt wonderful.

Though… if someone questioned me or tried to slow me down, I could get pretty snappish. I told myself they just didn’t understand, but looking back, I probably acted like they were standing in my way.
During that high-energy period, did your behavior cause serious problems in your life?

I… suppose it did, yes. I don’t like saying that, because I really was trying to help, but my husband has had to step in with a lot of the household things I normally keep up with. And he’s been the one dealing with the historical society now, because I stopped following through on things I’d promised and then I just… couldn’t face the people who were waiting on me. That sounds bad, doesn’t it?
During that unusually energetic, upbeat period, did you ever have beliefs or perceptions that others said were not real?

I don’t think so… not in the sense of seeing things or hearing things, if that’s what you mean. I mean, I may have been a little overconfident about my ideas, and I’m sure I sounded unrealistic to people at times, but I don’t remember believing anything that wasn’t real.

Does that answer what you’re asking?
About how many days did that unusually energized, upbeat period last?

It wasn’t just a few days, I’m afraid. I kept thinking it was just me being productive, but… that overdriven stretch with the historical society project went on for about five months before it really fell apart. Does that sound like the kind of timeframe you mean?
